description: Use when researching how AI systems characterize a vendor, category, trend, or business topic across multiple platforms simultaneously. Returns consensus score, sentiment mix, key themes, and platform-by-platform breakdown. Example: AI in healthcare scores 0.78 consensus — key themes: clinical decision support, administrative automation, prior auth reduction — high consensus signals established narrative safe for board communications. Source: Stratalize AI citation composite. $0.50 USDC per call.
name: get_ai_consensus_on_topic
